annotations.title: Shops: the verified East End stores, and where each one is

description: Verified East End shops: 86 stores across 15 hamlets on the South Fork, North Fork and Shelter Island, in these categories: fashion, jewelry, swimwear, activewear, kids, toys, home, books, beauty, consignment, accessories, general-store, florist, antiques. Each row carries the address read off the brand's own store page at `sourceUrl`, a cross-checked coordinate with `coordSource` recording what corroborated it, `phone` where one is published, and the one-line `what` the guide keeps. The guide holds no opening hours for any shop, so no row carries an open/closed state or an hours line. `query` matches the name, the brand, the category and `what`, so 'bookshop', 'toys', 'flowers' and 'The Wharf Shop' all resolve. With no arguments nothing is looked up and the answer lists the categories and towns covered. Returns up to 8. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'bookshop', 'toys', 'flowers', 'swimwear', 'gift', or a store's name ('The Wharf Shop').

town.description: A hamlet ('Sag Harbor', 'East Hampton') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words.
